messages:
Marta: quick check — noticed the catalog toolbar starts wrapping filters onto two rows around 980px. attaching screenshot. do we prefer keeping a single-line toolbar with horizontal scroll or collapsing extra filters into an overflow menu? also thinking about the version pill microcopy: right now it shows 'Pinned' — feels vague. suggestions? :thinking:

AJ: Overflow menu for extra filters. single-line with scroll feels brittle for keyboard users. if we do overflow, make the summary deterministic (e.g., '3 filters applied'). :+1:

Kevin: +1 to overflow. on the version pill copy — avoid words that imply permanence. 'Lock version' scares me. 'Pin version' or 'Version pinned' is clearer. we should align copy with rollout UI where we already use 'pin'.

Emily: Accessibility nits: the performance badge contrast is borderline (I measured ~3.2:1). We should bump contrast or change the badge background to a darker tone. also add aria-labels for filter chips like `aria-label=\"filter: model size = 7B\"`.

Jamal: small product behavior nit — if someone pins a version in the compare table, that state should persist across route changes (e.g., switching from catalog -> model details -> back). otherwise people lose context. also on mobile: toolbar should collapse into a single line with an overflow chevron, not wrap.

Marta: good recaps. i sketched two quick variants in the mock: 

Variant A — single-line toolbar with horizontal scroll + left/right focus buttons when overflow exists. keyboard focus moves through visible chips; scroll is programmatic.

Variant B — responsive overflow: less important filters collapse into a kebab menu with a summary chip. keyboard goes to the kebab then opens menu.

Code snippet for A (rough):
```
.catalog-toolbar { display: flex; gap: 8px; overflow-x: auto; -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch; }
.catalog-toolbar:focus-within { outline: none; }
```

Which one feels safer for a11y? :eyes:

AJ: A11y-wise B is easier if the overflow becomes a proper menu (roving tabindex + aria-expanded). but either can work if we add accessible controls. B avoids horizontal scrolling which is tricky for keyboard-only users.

Kevin: agree with AJ. B seems more predictable. If we go B, microcopy: use 'Pin version' on the action, and the pill reads 'Pinned — v3.2.1' when active.

Emily: for the badge contrast i can propose 2 color swatches that keep brand hue but meet 4.5:1 for text. i'll attach in Figma. also accessibility labels for chips: `aria-label=\"filter: runtime: dedicated\"`.

Jamal: behavior note about persistence: we should store pinned-version in route state + localStorage for immediate consistency, and invalidate on logout/space switch. small dev question: is that OK with privacy?

Marta: good call. @Kevin can you approve copy change to 'Pin version' and @Emily will upload color swatches. i'll update mocks for Variant B and add an a11y checklist (keyboard nav, aria-labels, contrast). i'll follow up with a short PR outline. :thumbsup:

prod-bot: preview for catalog-toolbar/variant-B uploaded: https://deploy-previews.redwood.dev/preview/toolbar-variant-b — runs accessibility scan (basic) after build.
